entities.summary: Andrei Pavlovich Svetlakov is a Russian ice hockey forward currently playing for Traktor Chelyabinsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was drafted 178th overall by the Minnesota Wild in the 2017 NHL Entry Draft.
